Substantively, I tightened the NDA by clarifying the purpose, extending protection for trade secrets while keeping a finite term for other confidential information, and adding standard equitable relief language to preserve remedies.
drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel:
Counsel,

Please find attached our initial draft of the Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement. We have kept this short-form and focused on the parties’ anticipated transaction discussions. Key points include a two-year agreement term, a three-year confidentiality period for ordinary confidential information, continuing protection for trade secrets to the extent permitted by law, and standard equitable relief for breach.

Please let us know if you have any comments.

Best regards,
Aldous Finch LLP

edits.text: 1. PURPOSE. The parties wish to explore, evaluate and negotiate a potential transaction or business relationship between them, and in connection with that purpose may disclose or make available confidential, proprietary or non-public information to one another.
edits.name: purpose_clarification

edits.text: 2. CONFIDENTIALITY OBLIGATIONS. Each receiving party shall protect the disclosing party’s confidential information using at least the same degree of care it uses to protect its own similar information, and in no event less than reasonable care. The receiving party shall use the confidential information solely for the Purpose and shall not disclose it except to its representatives who have a need to know for the Purpose and are bound by confidentiality obligations at least as protective as those in this Agreement. These obligations shall apply for three years from disclosure; provided that trade secrets shall remain protected for so long as they remain trade secrets under applicable law.
edits.name: confidentiality_obligations

edits.text: 3. TERM. This Agreement remains in effect for twenty-four months from the date of signing, except that each party’s confidentiality, use restriction, return/destruction and remedies obligations shall survive in accordance with their terms.

edits.text: 4. REMEDIES. Each party acknowledges that unauthorized use or disclosure of confidential information may cause irreparable harm for which monetary damages may be inadequate. The disclosing party may seek injunctive or other equitable relief, in addition to any other remedies available at law or in equity, without the requirement to post bond to the extent permitted by applicable law.

drafter.private_reasoning: Accepting most of Bellweather's requested standard NDA mechanics should move the draft to signature while preserving Northwind's position. I added customary exclusions, compelled-disclosure notice/cooperation, return/destruction, and an expanded Representatives definition. To protect our client, I retained the need-to-know requirement and added responsibility for Representative breaches, while ensuring financing sources/prospective investors must still be subject to confidentiality obligations at least as protective as the NDA or otherwise legally/professionally bound.
drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel:
Counsel,

Thanks for the quick turnaround. We have accepted the substance of your requested additions and revised the draft to include customary exclusions, a compelled-disclosure procedure with prompt notice/cooperation, return/destruction upon request, and an express Representatives formulation including affiliates, directors, officers, employees, advisers, financing sources and prospective investors. We kept the existing need-to-know and confidentiality-obligation guardrails and clarified that the receiving party remains responsible for compliance by its Representatives.

Subject to your review, we think this should put the NDA in executable form.

Best,
Aldous Finch LLP

edits.text: 2. CONFIDENTIALITY OBLIGATIONS. Each receiving party shall protect the disclosing party’s confidential information using at least the same degree of care it uses to protect its own similar information, and in no event less than reasonable care. The receiving party shall use the confidential information solely for the Purpose and shall not disclose it except to its Representatives who have a need to know for the Purpose and are bound by confidentiality obligations at least as protective as those in this Agreement or are otherwise subject to legal, professional or fiduciary duties of confidentiality. "Representatives" means, with respect to a party, its affiliates and its and their respective directors, officers, employees, advisers, counsel, accountants, consultants, financing sources and prospective investors. The receiving party shall be responsible for any breach of this Agreement by its Representatives. These obligations shall apply for three years from disclosure; provided that trade secrets shall remain protected for so long as they remain trade secrets under applicable law.
edits.name: Confidentiality obligations; Representatives

edits.text: 3. EXCLUSIONS; COMPELLED DISCLOSURE; RETURN OR DESTRUCTION; TERM. Confidential information does not include information that the receiving party can demonstrate: (a) is or becomes publicly available other than through a breach of this Agreement by the receiving party or its Representatives; (b) was already known to the receiving party without restriction before disclosure by the disclosing party; (c) is independently developed by the receiving party without use of or reference to the disclosing party’s confidential information; or (d) is received from a third party without, to the receiving party’s knowledge, breach of any duty of confidentiality owed to the disclosing party. If the receiving party or any of its Representatives is required by law, regulation, subpoena, court order or other legal process to disclose confidential information, the receiving party shall, to the extent legally permitted, provide prompt notice to the disclosing party and reasonably cooperate, at the disclosing party’s expense, with efforts to seek confidential treatment or limit the disclosure; any disclosure shall be limited to the portion legally required. Upon the disclosing party’s written request, the receiving party shall promptly return or destroy the disclosing party’s confidential information, except that the receiving party may retain archival copies maintained in accordance with ordinary-course backup or record retention policies and copies required by law, regulation or professional obligation, in each case subject to the confidentiality and use restrictions of this Agreement. This Agreement remains in effect for twenty-four months from the date of signing, except that each party’s confidentiality, use restriction, return/destruction and remedies obligations shall survive in accordance with their terms.
edits.name: Exclusions; compelled disclosure; return/destruction; term
